title: Fragili idilli
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: The radiant image of the Mediterranean has started to waver in recent decades following the drastic effects of climate change. This leads to conflicts between the traditional epistemology of the Mediterranean and new topics related to the fragile ecosystems of the region. The essays gathered in this volume discuss these conflicts, bringing into dialog aspects of current ecocriticism with the most recent trends in Mediterranean Studies.
